name: Profile grid fill
oneLiner: a light profile page (face in a brand ring, name, handle, grid and reel tabs) swings up out of depth; its 3 x 3 grid of portrait posts fills tile by tile from crops of the brand's own screens, photo and mark, each dropping onto the glass with a loading flash, then the pinned post lifts off the grid toward camera as the rest dims and a pin pill stamps into its corner
say: when the speaker talks about their page or body of work ('this is what my page looks like now', 'I posted every day for a year') and lands on one post ('and this one is pinned for a reason', 'this is the one that started it'): the grid fills under the first line, the pinned post lifts on the second
